title: Purchased for large cans -  not suitable
text:
Purchased for large cans - not suitable. UPDATE - there may be a durability issue too. I am now having problems opening regular consumer size cans. It comes off the lip.

Had to think long and hard how to rate this. I got this for my mother who is a caregiver cook. They get what they call Number Ten (?) cans. I previously bought her crank swingaways and her employer did buy her one but they break quickly. I tried this out on normal cans at home and saw it was positively vicious and effective. Myself, I prefer the safety side cutter type.

She took it to work but promptly gave back to me saying it would not "latch on" at all. Not having any commercial cans to try at home I could not advise her.

I did not like the direction the ratchet worked in myself, but since I prefer the safety cutters anyway would not consider it for myself. I still use it when I want something fast opened but would not purchase again and of course if you have to open any big cans, especially from China she tells me, forget about it. As I mentioned in update, I have not used this much myself. Perhaps ten normal cans over these months and it is slipping.
